Split illustration. Left side: a beaker of water sitting on a table showing 'Evaporation' with small upward wavy arrows escaping only from the flat top surface of the liquid. Right side: a beaker of water over a Bunsen burner flame showing 'Boiling', with large circular bubbles forming at the very bottom and rising up through the entire body of the liquid.

A temperature-time graph (heating curve) for water. The vertical axis is Temperature in Celsius, horizontal axis is Time. The graph starts at -20, rises diagonally to 0, goes completely horizontal at 0, then rises diagonally to 100, goes completely horizontal again at 100, and then rises diagonally again.
